tasks.label: Verify (typecheck + test)
tasks.detail: Runs the real gates and prints both exit codes. GREEN = safe to commit.

tasks.label: Verify: typecheck only
tasks.command: bun run typecheck > ${TMPDIR}/crayola-tc.log 2>&1; echo "TYPECHECK EXIT: $?"; tail -20 ${TMPDIR}/crayola-tc.log

tasks.label: Verify: test only
tasks.command: bun run test > ${TMPDIR}/crayola-test.log 2>&1; echo "TEST EXIT: $?"; tail -30 ${TMPDIR}/crayola-test.log

tasks.label: Codex: run next task
tasks.detail: Runs the TASKS.md loop on the default model, per AGENTS.md rules.
tasks.command: codex exec --approve-for-me "Read AGENTS.md and TASKS.md. Implement the first unfinished task. Verify with ./scripts/verify.sh — it must print GREEN before you commit. Stage explicitly as AGENTS.md says, then commit. If a task fails verification twice, stop and record the blocker in TASKS.md instead of retrying."
